what: Master Version 2.49 — the CD V-700 and CD V-715 Radiological Survey Meters (COTT other-items-lionel-produced #700 / #715) were in the catalog TWICE: on Lionel PW - Other (S2WG6NA6GV, VFBTCA8NVK) and on Lionel PW - Items (BXADZXSE9H, BH7BTZF3F5). PW - Other is the tab for Lionel's non-train products (the U-Drive boat, Phono-Vision and Movie-Jector from the same COTT page are only there), so its rows stay and take the cleaner names from the PW - Items copies; the two PW - Items rows are removed (full rows below and in master_backups on the PC). The removed 715 row also held COTT text that ran on into the next entries. Brad owns neither meter (checked in his app 2026-10-17).
stated: Brad (2026-10-17): "yes" to looking at the duplicate meters, then "approve the delete" to the plan (keep PW - Other, cleaner names, remove the PW - Items copies)
